title: Monopoly Go 第三季度为 Hasbro 贡献4100万美元，九个月累计1.27亿美元
content:
Monopoly Go earned Hasbro $41m in Q3, taking its nine-month total to $127m – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Monopoly Go earned Hasbro $41m in the third quarter of 2026, bringing the licensor’s income from Scopely’s game to $127m for the first nine months of the year.
Hasbro reported the figures in its
Q3 results
on October 20, matching the
$41m it made in Q1
and slightly down from
Q2’s $44m
.
The nine-month total is also almost identical to last year, when Hasbro reported $126m of Monopoly Go revenue over the same period.
The quarter covered the
Looney Tunes takeover
, which followed
The Simpsons
and ran from July 29 to September 23. Scopely then
launched its Monster Mash season
on September 23, which includes crossovers with KPop Demon Hunters and Ghostbusters and runs until November 25.
Scopely says the game has passed 300m downloads, and Sensor Tower said in January that it was
the fastest game to reach $6bn in in-app purchase revenue
.
Hasbro’s digital and licensed gaming revenue rose 3% to $134.1m in Q3, and 7% to $390.9m year to date.
Hasbro also named KPop Demon Hunters, alongside Marvel and Transformers, as a leading brand in its Consumer Products business, where revenue grew 4% to $827.9m.
Magic: The Gathering passed $600m in quarterly revenue for the first time, reaching $616.1m (+34%).
